name: NCO device, flight cap (Cadet Airman / NCO)
size_basis: Diameter ~1.3 in: the disc is ~0.9 of the 1 1/2 in mark drawn on the Attachment 5 flight-cap figure (p.139, 57 px disc vs 64 px mark); the regulation gives no dimension. Earlier build used 0.9 in
provenance: drawn from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-8 "Cadet Airman and NCO flight cap" device: blue disc, silver rim, silver wings, red propeller

mounts.uniform: USAF-style flight cap (Class A / Class B / FDU)
mounts.rule: front left flap, centred halfway between the top and bottom of the flap, 1 1/2 in back from the front of the cap (6.2.2.2.2-3; Senior Member NCOs per ICL 25-02 (g))
Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device centred on the front of the cap (6.2.1.1.1 as changed by ICL 25-02)

documented: cadet NCOs and Airmen wear the metal Cadet Airman flight cap insignia (6.2.2.2.3)
Senior Member NCOs wear the NCO device (ICL 25-02 (g), Fig A5-8/9)
assumed: wing and propeller proportions (figure device is ~35 px across)
